entities.summary: The Palazzo Bernardo Nani Lucheschi, also called the Palazzo Nani Bernardo, is a Renaissance-style palace between the Palazzo Giustinian Bernardo and the larger and more grandiose Ca' Rezzonico, on the Grand Canal in the sestiere of Dorsoduro in Venice, Italy.
